title: The Man Who Gathered Wood on the Sabbath
description: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day. He was brought before Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation and placed under guard, because it was not yet clear what should be done with him. Then the Lord commanded that the man must die, so the entire congregation took him outside the camp and stoned him to death, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
